spring.application.name=api-gateway spring.config.import=optional:configserver:http://localhost:8888 # Fallback server.port=8083 eureka.client.service-url.defaultZone=http://localhost:8761/eureka/ eureka.instance.prefer-ip-address=true eureka.client.registry-fetch-interval-seconds=5 jwt.secret=mySecretKey404E635266556A586E3272357538782F413F4428
# Load balancer retry spring.cloud.loadbalancer.retry.enabled=true
# Global timeouts spring.cloud.gateway.httpclient.connect-timeout=5000 spring.cloud.gateway.httpclient.response-timeout=30s
# Fallback routes (also defined in GatewayConfig.java and config-server) spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].id=auth-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].uri=lb://auth-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].predicates[0]=Path=/auth/**,/users/**
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].id=trialprotocol-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].uri=lb://trialprotocol-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].predicates[0]=Path=/api/protocols/**
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].id=SubjectEnrollment spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].uri=lb://SubjectEnrollment spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].predicates[0]=Path=/api/subjects/**
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[3].id=visit-scheduling spring.cloud.gateway.routes[3].uri=lb://visit-scheduling spring.cloud.gateway.routes[3].predicates[0]=Path=/api/visits/**
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].id=adverseevent spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].uri=lb://adverseevent spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].predicates[0]=Path=/api/events/**
